query:
SELECT s.id as sku_id, s.name, pf.period_id, pf.opening_stock, pf.adjustments, p.label, p.sort_order 
FROM planning_fg pf 
JOIN skus s ON s.id = pf.sku_id 
JOIN periods p ON p.id = pf.period_id 
WHERE s.name LIKE '%Blueberry Mint%' AND s.weight = '50g'
ORDER BY p.sort_order 
LIMIT 12
